notes.title: The Tower Patch Notes [0.0.3]
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Sophistry Arc Games Lab dev here with an update!

Here are the patch notes:





Enhancer Menu Polish



The existing enhancer use menu feels a bit cluncky in my opinion so I tried to polish it a bit!

You can change whom to use the enhancer, which type of enhancer use, how many to use, and be able to take a look the before and after of the stats.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45474944/833d7d26a8a30342908ec6ab9440e99e0dd9b1b7.png"]



Full Auto Battle - Minimal Gambit-like Auto Battle AI Options



So sometimes we'd like to sit back and relax while playing. Seeing most of the game actions are more or less the same during combat so I've tried to implement this! You'll be able to access the Auto Battle function and Auto Battle options at the same menu of the Escape button.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45474944/64a64020f7334629a2e59e870488325f3c5b28c2.jpg"]



Simple Repeatable Quests



These quests take place outside of the Tower, so for now the locations are only overworld locations. You'll be going to the quests' location by riding the Airship. Unfortunately, there is currently no lore.

Once you're done with the quest, talk to the Guild Representative, and get the rewards. Then the next quest would increment, the level and rewards as well. Currently, it has randomized mob monster and bosses.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45474944/20f9363407a746625e8c3213dfa47cb7f7747642.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45474944/4bf8f2080f239ef00d9dd65e354d15326a6611b9.png"]



Misc. Changes

· Map Transitions should be fixed.

· Shop Perks should be fixed.

· Fixed Bats always dropping items.

· Fixed Character joined party is not fully healed.

· Yoroidoshi description and Slayer TP description changed according to Tyege's suggestion. Thank you very much!



Demo build is updated to match the base game build as well!



That's it, for now!

Thank you for your time, and have fun!

Sophistry Arc Games Lab

notes.title: The Tower Patch Notes [0.0.2]
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45474944/634ebcdb6ed6d68d41a4053841f5cdace8380d44.pngHello everyone! How's everyone doing?
Dev here with an update!


Added 30 playable / recruitable characters!
(21 Males, 19 Females now in total)
You can play as them or recruit 'em!

Added Journal
You can access your Journal at the menu screen by pressing X
In the Journal screen, you will see the following categories:

People
You may view character profiles you recruit here.
Class
You can view some details about classes here. What skill to learn at which level, what that class can equip, class stats parameters.
Skills
Skills casted or casted by enemies can be viewed here.
States
Skills inflicted to you or by enemies can be viewed here.
Reputation
You can now view party perk level at a bit detailed menu here. Formerly, there was no perks. You can also view unlocked shop items that depends on your Guild Level here.
Enemies
You can now view enemies you fought here. You may also take a look at how many times you took a specific enemy which I think is pretty cool.

Added Credits

Added Battle Cursor Memory
You may toggle this at the Settings Menu.

Added partial support for custom music
Subscribed items at workshop will play as custom music. You can toggle this at the Settings Menu.
You can also have local custom music as well
*game directory*/Audio/BGM/custom/*
(Put your .ogg files in these folders)
battle*
boss*

Hidden Save Button in Load screen at title

You can now view details on the character who you want or potentially want to recruit.

You can also view your Reputation, playtime, and current real life time at the menu screen.

Partial Workshop Support for Custom Music
*Currently, please voice your requests at Discord, I haven't found a way how to upload workshop item easily. Apologies also for opening the Workshop a bit early.

Removed Legacy Menus

Note: 
Shop Perks currently don't work, I'm sorry
Characters to recruit at the guild are a bit awkwardly spawning at load or at Tower exit, currently finding a way how to fix this.
Old save files might not work, apologies. But do keep your old save file.


No worries, demo players! The demo build is updated to match the base build as well.

We also have a discord server!
https://discord.gg/BQh7pD3ESK


That's it, for now!
Thank you for your time, and have fun!
Sophistry Arc Games Lab

notes.title: The Tower Patch Notes [0.0.1a]
notes.notes:
Hello! Sophistry Arc Games Lab Dev here!
A small update for the demo.



Added a visual menu for character select and shop menu! (Legacy Menu are kept and still can be used.)



Added Roguelike Mode!: Plays the same as the base mode / game but your character resets when you are defeated or exited The Tower. You can store and take items/weapons/armors in a chest in The Tower's Guild. (Every run, you can store 1 item/weapon/armor after. Your equips and used Enhancers are kept, but be sure to use them before going on a run again.) 



That's it, for now!
I will do my best updating the game little by little!
Sophistry Arc Games Lab
